caption: The drawing features three distinct objects arranged vertically on a plain, off-white background. The top two objects are rectangular containers with short legs, decorated with intricate patterns; the top container has a floral motif with a single flower and leaves on its side, and a patterned border near the rim. The middle container, similar in shape, displays a cluster of grapes or a floral bouquet on its side with a border that includes a scroll design. Both containers appear to be composed of a transparent or reflective material, suggested by the use of shading, and are colored in grayscale. The bottom object is a rectangular plaque or label with rounded corners, featuring a raised border and four circular elements at the corners. Inside the border, the text "N E GLASS COMPANY BOSTON" is embossed in capital letters within a central oval. The composition is executed with pencil and ink, showing careful attention to detail and shading to indicate three-dimensional forms. The background is left plain, and the overall color scheme is monochromatic, consisting of various shades of gray and black.
title: Salt Cellar
